internal.title: flagd Service Error Rate Spike - Escalated Incident
internal.body: At 11:50 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the flagd service. Multiple diagnosis rounds were conducted, including checks for error injection, latency, and resource exhaustion across related services such as frontend, frontend-proxy, and checkout. No abnormal error rates or resource issues were found in these components. After three rounds of diagnosis without conclusive evidence, the incident was escalated to the on-call engineer for further investigation. No root cause was identified during the initial diagnosis phase.
